translations.风里带着腥气。: The wind carried the smell of blood.
translations.姜月初还没能接受，自己穿越成了陌生女子。: Jiang Yuechu still could not accept that she had crossed over into a stranger's body.
translations.大唐。妖魔。罪臣之女。发配边疆。: Great Tang. Demons. A traitor's daughter. Exiled to the frontier.
translations.是妖魔。还好……是死的。: A demon. Good... it was dead.
translations.她只想跑。没有户籍路引，也好过去边疆送死。: She only wanted to run. No household papers was still better than dying on the frontier.
translations.在下裴长青，陇右镇魔都司队正。: I am Pei Changqing, squad captain of the Longyou Demon Suppression Office.
translations.按我说的做，我保你脱籍。: Do as I say, and I will get you out of bondage.
translations.都说人死不能复生。可没人告诉她，妖死也不行。: They said the dead could not rise. No one told her demons were the same.
translations.此妖，已半只脚踏入鸣骨之境。: This demon had already stepped halfway into the Bone-Ringing realm.
translations.真以为凭你们，便能杀我？: Did you truly think the likes of you could kill me?
translations.就在她彻底绝望之际，一副古朴绘卷徐徐展开。: Just as despair swallowed her, an ancient scroll slowly unfurled.
translations.斩杀生物，可获得对应道行。: Kill a living being to gain its cultivation.
translations.荒野之上，除了杀不死的虎妖，唯一还活着的生物……: On this wasteland, besides the undying tiger demon, the only living being left...
translations.下一秒，长刀没入他的胸口。: The next moment, the long blade sank into his chest.
